replies.author: hcnem
replies.body:
Hello,

Since you have been banned for quite a long time, and no alts have been recorded ban evading on your behalf, I will accept your appeal. However, if you are banned again, your chances of being appealed will be significantly lower. Remember to read the rules (http://avicus.net/rules), and welcome back.

Regards,
PeachyYas | Senior Moderator
